capabilities: Transcribe microphone speech to text in real time (local SenseVoice or cloud)
Boost recognition of custom hot words and apply error=>correction rules
Translate non-Chinese transcripts and polish spoken text into written prose with AI
Generate rolling AI summaries and an aggregate summary at character thresholds
Export transcripts as Markdown notes with timestamp, AI, or manual naming
extras: Cloud-hosted mode is a paid service with server-side billing; the README warns that data.json may contain API keys or tokens and should not be committed to Git; local mode keeps audio on-device while cloud mode sends audio to the chosen ASR provider.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in live speech recognition, so users cannot dictate directly into notes or automatically turn spoken audio into text.

relations.evidence: 本地实时转写 | SenseVoice-Small + Silero VAD + sherpa-onnx
海外默认使用 Deepgram Nova-3
中国大陆默认使用腾讯云
自动调用 OpenAI 兼容 API 翻译成中文
支持 OpenAI 兼容 API、Claude Code CLI、Codex CLI 和 OpenCode CLI

requires.name: Python 3.10–3.12 and ~240 MB local model (local mode)

summary: Real-time speech-to-text plugin that transcribes microphone audio via local SenseVoice or cloud services, with hot words, correction rules, translation, polishing and AI summaries.
